## Welcome!

This is a three-day course for people who want to build R packages that are robust, maintainable, and easy for others to use.

**Code of Conduct:**

- Treat everyone with respect
- Everyone should feel welcome
- Full text: <https://andyteucher.ca/dfo-advanced-r-pkgs-2026/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html>

## Check your setup

Run these two commands and make sure they succeed before we begin:

```{r}
devtools::has_devel()
```

Look for 
`Your system is ready to build packages!`



::: {.fragment}
```{r}
usethis::git_sitrep()
```

Look for 
`Personal access token for 'https://github.com': '<discovered>'`
:::

::: {.notes}
Give people 2-3 minutes to run these. has_devel() should print "Your system is ready to build packages!". For git_sitrep(), the key thing to check is that the PAT shows as discovered and their name/email are correct. If anyone is stuck, now is the time to sort it out before we get into content.
:::
